card.what: Cast aluminium open-base horn cleat, 6 in (150 mm): dock lines, the anchor rode and halyard tails on small keelboats
card.boats: J/22 bow and stern cleats (layouts/j22.json), the Sunfish's 100 mm size (layouts/sunfish.json), build_fleet.py's cleats
card.distance: arm's reach on the foredeck and dock; the camera passes close when docking
card.before: kit HornCleat from horn_cleat (Oct 2026): a tapered box base and one swept arch

references.use: outline and proportions (square-on side view of a cast open-base cleat on a dock; proportions only)
three-quarter view of a solid-base cast cleat: knob ends, fillets, bolt heads
the J/22's deck hardware at Rush Creek (cleats in the distance only)
references.url: project upload 84310630 (Bean, J/22 at Rush Creek)

references.note: Sea-Dog 6 in open-base cleat: height 1.88 in (47.8 mm). Other 6 in cast aluminium cleats: Attwood 6 x 1-13/32 in (low closed base), bolt centres 1 to 2 in (sailboatparts.com, flagdesk.com)

features.text: Two horns tapering to rounded knob ends, a little upswept
Top nearly level, a shallow dip between the bolts
Waisted pedestal flaring out to a long flat foot
Round line hole through the pedestal
Soft cast fillets where the horns meet the pedestal: one casting, no seams
Two bolt heads on the top flat
Room for a 12 mm line under each horn
Flat underside, sits on the deck with no gap

budget.note: hero is a Nanite part; build_kit makes the light copy at a quarter of the triangles
